<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex088012026-03-0412-13-45" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (122b)"/>
         de ltar <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5472"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3772">rnam 'grel</rs> gsal bar byed pa'i zin bris rin chen snying po</rs> 'di <mentioned>||</mentioned>
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">gnas lnga rig pa'i paN chen</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6059">chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po</rs></note> nyid dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6057">blo gros chos kyi <lb n="122b1"/> seng ge</rs> yi | 
         gsung rgyun las byung [mod|mdo tsam] 'god pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5870">shAkya'i dge slong a nan ta</rs>s rang <note type="gloss">rjed pas 'jigs pa dang bdag blo ma nyams</note> <choice><reg>gzhan gyi don</reg><orig>gzhan ‹gyi› don</orig></choice> du bgyis pa'i dge bas don dam tshad ma rtogs par shog ||
         <note type="translation">Thus, by the virtue of the composition of this treasure-heart record that clarifies the PV by the buddhist monk Ananda, who presents in brief (?) what stemms from the lineage of the teaching of the Pandit of the 5 sciences (chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po) and Blo gros chos kyi seng ge for the sake of oneself (by fear of forgetting and in order for my mind to be unspoiled) and others, may one understand the ultimate tshad ma!</note></seg></TEI>
